title: Combining Long-Term Memory and LLMs Comes at a High Cost: From Prompt Injection to Persistent Compromise
abstract: arXiv:2610.28810v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The widespread adoption of generative artificial intelligence in recent years has brought a parallel rise in prompt injection and jailbreak attacks. By embedding malicious instructions, these exploits manipulate language models to bypass intended behavior and operational boundaries. In traditional chatbots, such attacks are confined to a single session because state memory is not preserved across conversations. However, persistent memory features in modern conversational interfaces enable cross-session attack propagation, establishing a threat vector known as memory injection. This work explores this emerging vulnerability in leading LLM-as-a-service platforms, highlighting its real-world severity and the need for countermeasures. While existing literature focuses on violations tailored to specific platform features, we present a general threat model. We demonstrate that all NIST attack goals are collectively achievable across ChatGPT

translated_title: 将长期记忆与大语言模型结合需付出高昂代价：从提示注入到持久性入侵
translated_abstract: 近年来，生成式人工智能的广泛普及也带来了提示注入和越狱攻击的同步增长。这些攻击手段通过嵌入恶意指令来操纵语言模型，使其绕过预期的行为和操作边界。在传统聊天机器人中，由于状态记忆不会跨对话保留，此类攻击仅限于单个会话内。然而，现代对话界面中的持久记忆功能使得攻击能够跨会话传播，形成了一种被称为“记忆注入”的威胁向量。本工作在领先的大语言模型即服务平台中探讨了这一新兴漏洞，强调了其现实世界的严重性以及采取对策的必要性。现有文献主要关注针对特定平台功能定制的违规行为，而我们提出了一个通用的威胁模型。我们证明了所有NIST攻击目标在ChatGPT等平台上均可共同实现。
tldr: 本文揭示了现代对话式AI平台的持久记忆功能使提示注入攻击能够跨会话传播（记忆注入），并提出通用威胁模型证明所有NIST攻击目标均可实现，凸显了这一新型安全威胁的严重性与紧迫性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that persistent memory features in modern conversational LLM platforms enable prompt injection attacks to propagate across sessions (memory injection), and presents a general threat model demonstrating that all NIST attack goals are achievable, highlighting the severity of this emerging security threat.
